lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item SOLD $40 / 1.198 = $33.39, round down to $30. Flip: likely resale about $70 (middle of the $40 and $100 same-item hammers; no retail evidence verified), less 13% selling fee allowance = $60.90, outbound postage $0 (bulky resin, sell as local pickup), / 2.396 = $25.42, round down to $25. Both sales within 24 months.
lots.confidence_reason: Shape, finish and mould match two opened same-item Gowans SOLD results, but no maker's mark was read (the round sticker at the top of the head is a blurry number sticker, roughly 3x4, not a maker's logo) and the earlier same bust needed six listings to sell.

lots.condition: Front looks clean with no obvious chips or breaks to ears or mane points; back and underside not photographed.
lots.question_for_gowans: Is there an Edge Sculpture or Matt Buckley mark or sticker on the base, and are the ear tips, mane points and fangs free of chips or repairs? Is this the same tiger bust that was offered in July and August?
